summary:
APPROVE — task #4 (integrate LLM grader into runAgenticContextSearches), attempt 69f68311. Floor preservation is genuinely guaranteed by the code (traced, not asserted on trust):

FLOOR PRESERVATION (the critical guarantee):
- filterAgenticContextResults (UNCHANGED by the diff) produces the heuristic floor = filtered.selected; selected/rejected partition the ranked set.
- applyGraderSelection: floor=filtered.selected; added = ONLY members of filtered.rejected whose key is in grader.kept_keys (disjoint from floor); union=[...floor,...added]; return is a stable partition of union (keptFirst ++ rest). Every union element lands in exactly one bucket — nothing dropped. So selection ⊇ floor, |selection| ≥ |floor|. Superset-or-equal proven.
- composeSearchContextEnvelope grader path: selected = graded.selection.slice(0,max); the final-confidence/hasSufficientContext gate is fully BYPASSED on the grader path — the empty-on-low-confidence branch is reachable ONLY when graderOn===false. So the 0.346 abstain-to-empty regression cannot recur.
- abstain keeps floor: kept_keys empty ⇒ added empty ⇒ union=floor ⇒ selection=floor (returned in full). Proven + test-covered.

NO WEDGE: per-round grader uses the in-process api-kind backend; createDefaultGraderBackend THROWS on agentic-cli (kind!=='api'), and the integration catches that throw → degrades to heuristic. No lazily-spawned sidecar in the loop. rerank untouched.

SAFETY: feature flag OFF by default (graderRequested false ⇒ graderCtx=null ⇒ graderActive false ⇒ runGraderExtension is a no-op and graderOn false ⇒ original heuristic branch runs verbatim — confirmed by 34 pre-existing tests still green). gradeSearchRound is contracted never-throw (backend error + parse failure both return conservative fallback continue:false/kept:[]/abstain:true); the loop also guards with try/catch. Double round cap in runGraderExtension: grader.rounds>=maxRounds (default 4, env ORCH_GRADER_MAX_ROUNDS, clamped [1,6]) AND planner.searches.length>
